checklistGeneric: Coaching is evidence-based from a scored interaction
Actions are agreed with dates
Session is documented in the coaching log
checklistSpecific: Play the scored interaction with the representative and agree what was observed
Give behavioural feedback tied to the specific rubric item rather than the overall score
Agree two actions with dates and record them in the coaching log
Book the follow-up review date before the session ends
Confirm the representative acknowledged the coaching record

testing.expected: Coaching record with observation, agreed actions, dates and acknowledgement

checklistGeneric: Prior coaching is evidenced before escalation
Escalation carries objective data
Improvement plan dates are recorded
checklistSpecific: Evidence the trend with at least three consecutive scored periods below target
Confirm coaching actions were documented and followed up before escalating
Raise the formal performance concern to the operations manager with the evidence pack attached
Record the escalation and the agreed improvement plan review dates

testing.expected: Formal performance concern logged with supporting quality evidence and review dates

checklistGeneric: Themes are derived from failed rubric items
Themes are ranked by frequency and impact
Top themes are published for the coaching cycle
checklistSpecific: Group failed rubric items into themes covering authentication, resolution accuracy, documentation and tone
Rank the themes by frequency and by customer impact, not by ease of fixing
Identify which themes are team-wide and which sit with individuals
Publish the top three themes for the next coaching cycle so coaching is consistent

testing.expected: Ranked theme list derived from failed rubric items for the period

checklistGeneric: Each quality theme maps to a curriculum module
Content is refreshed with real examples
Completion is tracked
checklistSpecific: Map every recurring quality theme to a specific module in the curriculum
Rewrite the module content and refresh the call examples using recent anonymised interactions
Add the theme to the new-hire nesting checkpoints so it is caught early
Track completion of the refreshed module in the learning system
Confirm the next quality cycle shows movement on the targeted theme

testing.expected: Updated module with revision date traceable to the quality finding

checklistGeneric: Scorecard uses the agreed rubric and definitions
Trend against target is shown
Actions carry owners and dates
checklistSpecific: Produce the scorecard with team, individual and rubric-category views
Show the trend against target for the last six reporting periods
List the improvement actions with named owners and due dates
Circulate the pack ahead of the monthly business review rather than presenting cold

testing.expected: Published scorecard with team, individual and category views for the period

checklistGeneric: Sample covers all channels
Minimum per-representative volume is met
Selection method is reproducible
checklistSpecific: Draw the monthly sample covering calls, chats and written correspondence
Ensure at least five interactions per representative are included each month
Include a proportion of escalated and complaint interactions in the sample
Record the selection method and date range so the sample can be reproduced

testing.expected: Monthly sample with at least five interactions per representative across channels

checklistGeneric: Every score carries a written justification
Auto-fail rules are applied consistently
Score is released and acknowledged
checklistSpecific: Score each rubric item and write a comment justifying the mark given
Apply the auto-fail rules where authentication or a required disclosure was missed
Record the score against the representative inside the scoring window
Release the score to the representative and log their acknowledgement
Attach the interaction reference so the score can be re-checked

testing.expected: Per-item scores with comments and interaction reference recorded
No scored item below target left without a written comment

checklistGeneric: Trends are tracked per representative over time
Coaching effectiveness is measured
Stalled improvement is escalated
checklistSpecific: Plot each representative score across the last six months rather than judging on one month
Compare pre-coaching and post-coaching scores for the same rubric item
Flag representatives showing no improvement after two coaching cycles
Record the trend review outcome in the coaching log

testing.expected: Six-period score trend available per representative

checklistGeneric: Change notices trigger a standards review
Updates are versioned with effective dates
Superseded versions are withdrawn
checklistSpecific: Review the change notice and identify which rubric items and call guides are affected
Update the call guide wording and republish with a new version number
Communicate the effective date so scoring does not penalise pre-change behaviour
Archive the superseded version in the document repository rather than deleting it
Confirm the learning system reflects the updated guide

testing.expected: New version published with effective date linked to the product or process change

checklistGeneric: Responses are consolidated into one dataset
Responses are linked back to the interaction
Response rate is reported alongside scores
checklistSpecific: Consolidate NPS, CSAT and CES responses into a single dataset for the period
Join each response back to the interaction, the handling agent and the reason code
Exclude duplicate and test responses before reporting
Report the response rate alongside the scores so the sample size is visible

testing.expected: Period dataset with response linked to interaction, agent and reason code

checklistGeneric: Verbatims are coded to driver categories
Drivers are ranked by impact
Findings trace back to a process step
checklistSpecific: Code the free-text verbatims into driver categories rather than reading them anecdotally
Rank detractor drivers by volume and by their effect on the overall score
Trace each top driver back to the specific process step that failed
Document the findings with supporting verbatim examples for each driver

testing.expected: Coded verbatim categories ranked by volume and score impact

checklistGeneric: Peer set and metric definitions are stated
Definitional differences are disclosed
Gap list is documented
checklistSpecific: Select the peer benchmark set and confirm the metrics are defined the same way
Compare first contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT and NPS against the benchmark
Note definitional differences that distort the comparison rather than ignoring them
Document the benchmark source, date and the resulting gap list

testing.expected: Benchmark comparison with source, date and metric definitions recorded

checklistGeneric: Detractor alerts are worked within the contact standard
Complaints are logged where the definition is met
Root causes feed the improvement backlog
checklistSpecific: Work the detractor alert queue within the 48-hour contact standard
Call the customer and acknowledge the specific issue raised in their survey response
Log a complaint record where the feedback meets the complaint definition
Record the outcome and whether the customer view changed after the call
Feed the root cause into the service improvement backlog

testing.expected: Follow-up contact logged within 48 hours for each detractor alert
No detractor alerts older than the contact standard without an attempt logged

checklistGeneric: Updates are published to the knowledge base
Briefing attendance is recorded
Understanding is checked afterwards
checklistSpecific: Publish the update to the knowledge base with an effective date before briefing staff
Cover the change in the team huddle and record attendance
Confirm the knowledge article and the customer portal content say the same thing
Spot-check agent understanding of the change in the next quality sample

testing.expected: Published article with effective date and recorded briefing attendance

checklistGeneric: Every action has a named owner and due date
Owner acceptance is recorded
Actions link to the root-cause finding
checklistSpecific: Write each action with a named owner, a due date and a measurable outcome
Confirm the owner accepted the action before it is logged as assigned
Link the action to the root-cause finding that generated it
Review open actions at the weekly service improvement stand-up

testing.expected: Each action carries owner, due date and linked root-cause finding

checklistGeneric: Survey fires within the defined window
Fatigue suppression rules are applied
Dispatch health is monitored
checklistSpecific: Confirm the survey trigger fires inside the defined window after contact closure
Suppress customers already surveyed within the fatigue exclusion period
Check the survey link renders correctly on mobile before release
Monitor dispatch volumes and bounce rates daily and fix delivery failures

testing.expected: Dispatch record within the defined post-contact window for eligible contacts
No customers surveyed inside the fatigue exclusion period

checklistGeneric: Design starts from a documented root cause
Process map and SOP text are drafted
Process owner signs off before build
checklistSpecific: Document the root cause and name the specific process step being changed
Draft the revised process map and the updated standard operating procedure text
Assess the training, system and customer communication impact of the change
Obtain process owner sign-off before any build work starts
Define how the improvement will be measured after go-live

testing.expected: Root cause, revised process map and process owner sign-off recorded

checklistGeneric: Documentation is published before go-live
Training completion is recorded
Post-go-live checks are performed
checklistSpecific: Confirm the updated SOP and knowledge articles are published before go-live, not after
Complete agent training and record completion in the learning system
Deploy the system or routing change inside the agreed release window
Run a first-day check on volumes, handle time and error events after go-live
Keep the rollback path available until the first-week check passes

testing.expected: Change deployed with linked SOP update and training completion evidence

checklistGeneric: VOC themes are attributed to owning process areas
Forums accept named owners
Impact is re-measured next period
checklistSpecific: Prepare the voice-of-customer pack for the product, underwriting and claims review forums
Attribute each theme to the owning process area rather than presenting it as service feedback
Secure a named owner for every theme the forum accepts
Track whether the forum actions moved the related customer metric in the following period

testing.expected: Themes attributed to owning process areas with accepted owners recorded

checklistGeneric: Baseline is defined before the change
Unintended effects are checked
Benefit is confirmed or refuted in writing
checklistSpecific: Compare the target metric against its pre-change baseline over an equal-length period
Check for unintended movement in handle time, first contact resolution and repeat-contact rate
Confirm or refute the benefit in writing at the agreed checkpoint
Reopen the improvement action where the expected benefit did not materialise

testing.expected: Pre and post baseline comparison recorded with a stated conclusion

checklistGeneric: Pack covers service level, quality and customer metrics
Variances are explained
Decisions and actions are minuted
checklistSpecific: Build the monthly review pack with service level, quality, CSAT and complaint views
Lead with the variances against target and the reason for each
Present the open action list with current status and due dates
Record decisions and new actions in the review minutes and circulate them

testing.expected: Published pack with SLA, quality, CSAT and complaint views for the period

checklistGeneric: Scoring criteria are explicit
Effort and dependencies are assessed
Ranked list is agreed with management
checklistSpecific: Score each initiative on customer impact, contact volume and cost-to-serve
Estimate effort and identify dependencies for each initiative
Rank the backlog and confirm the top items with operations management
Publish the ranked list with the scoring rationale visible to owners

testing.expected: Initiatives scored on impact, volume and cost with a published ranking

checklistGeneric: Benefits are reported against what was committed
Remaining gaps carry plans and dates
Report reaches leadership before the governance meeting
checklistSpecific: Report benefits realised against the benefits committed for each initiative
Show remaining gap areas with the plan and the date to close each one
Include the customer metric trend across the reporting period
Circulate the report to senior leadership ahead of the governance meeting

testing.expected: Committed versus realised benefits reported per initiative with gap plans
